subject: Private deployment: maintenance handoff & fast-recovery play
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@mercuryfin.com
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: maintenance handoff & fast-recovery play

Team —

Following the customer call with Mercury Financial this morning, I want to lock in a coordinated maintenance plan for their private VPC deployment (PRV-8421). High level asks: a single 3-hour maintenance window, a verified canary, and a documented fast-recovery path that doesn't require full live rollback unless absolutely necessary.

Proposed window: 2025-06-02 02:00–05:00 PT (customer-preferred night).

What I need from you both:
- Aditya: a short, actionable tech handoff and the exact abort/rollback commands we will use. Include network gating steps and expected service impact.
- Stephanie: the comms timeline for customer ops and internal support rotation, plus the customer-facing runbook excerpt.

Attached: vpc_upgrade_handoff_runbook.pdf (draft), maintenance_window_calendar.ics, net-topology-v2.png.

Goal: schedule a dry-run the week prior (canary against a staging slice that mirrors Mercury's routing) and get sign-off from their ops. Please respond with confirmations and any blockers by end of day.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, ops@mercuryfin.com
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance handoff & fast-recovery play

Laura —

ACK on the proposed window. Quick technical sequence and recovery plan, high-level: 

Preflight (T-72h to T-1h):
- Snapshot persistent volumes (etcd/kv) and tag with PRV-8421-20250602.
- Verify healthy KV cache warm; collect baseline tail latency and cpu/gpu utilization.
- Push updated kernel/behavior to staging canary (same model variant + quantization profile).

Maintenance sequence (Day-of):
1) Announce maintenance to internal channels and pause scheduled jobs (5m).
2) Put affected nodes into traffic-drain: change local LB weight -> 0, wait for in-flight requests (max 45s).
3) Apply network quiesce rules (deny new connections from non-control subnets, keep mgmt/BGP).
4) Snapshot service state (quick DB checkpoint) and confirm write barrier.
5) Deploy canary to one AZ slice (10% traffic) for 15min smoke tests (latency, cold-start, tail).
6) If PASS -> roll to 50% for 10min; monitor tracing spans for model regressions.
7) Full rollout in 15–30min increments, watching per-AZ throttles.

Abort / Fast-recovery options (in order):
A) Immediate canary rollback: revert canary instance to previous image and reweight (under 6m).
B) Shelve new model variant by remapping routing policy to pinned version (no node restart).
C) If network-level failure observed, execute VPC route rollback (restore previous route table).
D) Full unpin + node restart only if data corruption suspected (worst-case, 30–45m).

Network specifics:
- We will not modify BGP neighbors during the window to avoid churn; any required NAT/SNAT ACL changes must be staged pre-window with a quick toggle flag.
- Plan for ephemeral circuit for dry-run to eliminate propagation risk.

Telemetry & gating:
- Gate 1 (canary): 99% success on 1k sample requests, no >30% tail latency spike.
- Gate 2 (50%): no new error class introduced in SLOs; triggered alerts must auto-pause rollout.

I will prepare the exact switch commands and a one-page cheat sheet (will attach) by EOD. Dry-run proposal: 2025-05-28 02:00–03:00 PT (staging slice).

—Aditya
Senior Systems Engineer, Runtime
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Andre Jensen <andre.jensen@mercuryfin.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance handoff & fast-recovery play

Thanks, both. A few comms and SLA notes:

Customer comms sequence (T-72h -> T+24h):
- T-72h: send maintenance advisory + short FAQ (what will be impacted, rollback expectations).
- T-24h: reminder + ops POC + Pager rotation.
- T-1h: final TTL and live status channel link (we'll use the Mercury ops Slack channel).
- T+1h: initial postmortem stub (what changed, immediate mitigations).

SLA & credits: Mercury asked about guardrails for credits in case of >30m of TTF (time-to-fix). I'll draft suggested wording but propose we escalate exceptions to Revenue for sign-off pre-window.

Runbook ownership: I'll own the customer-facing runbook excerpt and the status page updates. Laura — can you confirm whether we should include the exact abort commands in the customer-facing doc or keep them internal? My preference is to keep sensitive commands internal and provide high-level rollback bullets to the customer.

I will publish the customer advisory and link the calendar invite (attached).

—Stephanie
Head of Customer Reliability
From: Andre Jensen <andre.jensen@mercuryfin.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 16:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance handoff & fast-recovery play

Thanks for the clear plan. Mercury ops prefers the night window you proposed (06/02 02:00–05:00 PT). A couple of asks from our side: 
- Please include a network diagram showing which transit circuits will be affected. The attached net-topology-v2.png looks right but can you add ASNs and peering links?
- We need a dry-run against a mirror slice and a short runbook for our NOC with the expected observable flags.
- Our team requests the maintenance lead phone number (on-call) and a 24h hold period for rollback if we see unexpected financial transaction lag.

If those items are satisfied, we can sign-off this week.

—Andre Jensen
Head of Ops, Mercury Financial
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@reditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Andre Jensen <andre.jensen@mercuryfin.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance handoff & fast-recovery play

Thanks Andre — noted. Action items and assignment: 
- Aditya: please add ASNs/peering labels to net-topology-v2.png and attach the quick-switch command cheat sheet to the runbook. Prioritize the dry-run checklist (we will run 05/28 02:00–03:00 PT).
- Stephanie: you'll publish the customer advisory and create the NOC runbook summary for Mercury; keep abort commands internal as suggested.
- Laura (me): I'll be maintenance lead on 06/02 and will provide my mobile for the window. I'll also create an Ops Zoom bridge and enable the Mercury Slack channel.

Putting the calendar invite on the shared runbook folder now. Please confirm once your artifacts are uploaded and I'll send the sign-off packet to Andre.

Laura
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Andre Jensen <andre.jensen@mercuryfin.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance handoff & fast-recovery play

ACK. Will update net-topology-v2.png with ASNs and peering labels by EOD and attach the one-page cheat sheet to the runbook. Dry-run confirmed for 05/28 02:00–03:00 PT — I'll execute the canary script and capture traces.
